notes.title: Yukar From The Abyss is fully released!
notes.content:
[h2]Yukar From The Abyss is fully released![/h2]

We have finally left Early Access and released the full version of Yukar From The Abyss.
Be sure to update your game files now to unlock Pewrep and Huaisu's story routes and all the latest features!

[h3]Important Note For Those Upgrading From Early Access.[/h3]

[list]
[*]Old save data may cause errors or weird behavior in the game. Some very old save may not load at all.
In this case please start from New game or Chapter list.
[*]The death counter for Steam Achievements will start from 0 even if you already died in a previous playthrough.
[*]Steam Achievements will be unlocked by reaching the end of a playthrough.
[*]You can skip the end credits by pressing Esc 
[/list]

We really hope you enjoy the full story of Yukar From The Abyss! 
Thank you for all your support. 

Keep an eye out for future updates.

-LocaGames

notes.title: Yukar From The Abyss Full Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[h3]We're happy to announce the full release of [b]Yukar From The Abyss[/b] will officially launch [b]August 22nd![/b][/h3]

Everything is now in place, with just a few last-minute things to polish before the big day. We really appreciate your patience and hope you enjoy your playthroughs of the full story. 

As previously mentioned, the full release will include Steam Achievements, New CGs to collect in Pewrep and Huaisu's newly added routes, Some changes and additions to Kyril and Moshirechik's previously released routes, upgraded backgrounds, better controller support and Steam Deck compatibility, and much more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649985/8a18b0f9b19d730db2a4ce71581c6e5754c6e148.png[/img]

notes.title: Official Full Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Thank you so much to everyone who has been following our progress on Yukar From the Abyss![/b][/h2]

Today we are very pleased to announce that Yukar From the Abyss will be leaving Early Access and will fully release on June 30th, JPT!

In the release update, both Pewrep and Huaisu's routes will be unlocked and available to play for everyone. 

[h3]IMPORTANT[/h3]
From May 25th, the price of the game will increase slightly, leaving Early Access pricing and moving into release pricing. 
However, please do not feel any pressure to purchase the game before the full release in order to get a discount, as we will run a launch sale which will keep the price the same as it is currently for a little while after launch. 

We really hope you enjoy the new stories, and thank you all for your patience!

-LocaGames

notes.title: April Development Update
notes.content:
Greetings everyone! We hope you are all well and enjoying the spring weather.

Work continues on Yukar From the Abyss at full speed! We have recently been optimizing our workflow as much as possible in the team to speed up development, and hopefully, it will help us get the next two routes to you in a timely manner.

We are wrapping up the final text in Japanese for the Pewrep and Huaisu routes and will be moving into translation (if all goes well) next week. Again, we have a plan to refine this process and produce fewer errors overall while maintaining our current date targets. 

While translation is underway we will complete the programming and initial playtests for the new routes. Final character art and CGs should also be completed within the next few weeks. 

We have a release date in mind, but we will hold back announcing it at this stage until we have a clearer picture of where the game is at the end of April. But we are confident we will hit our targets and, of course, keep you up to date on the newest happenings as we hit our milestones! 

Thank you as always for your continued support and patience. We are so pleased with all the positive feedback and kind words from our community and we will do our very best to bring you a game that will exceed your expectations! 

Until next time!

-LocaGames

notes.title: March Development Update.
notes.content:
All of us here at LocaGames have been hard at work on the next installments for Yukar From the Abyss, and we have made a lot of good progress that we would like to share with you all!

We've been updating our current built and released v1.3 around a month ago with a new UI, updated/changed background artwork, and text fixes (many thanks to our amazing community for sharing mistakes we had missed in our Discord!). 
We hope you have been enjoying the new look!

So, moving forward, many of you are waiting patiently for the Pewrep and Li Huaisu routes. We are making good progress, but we are unfortunately a little behind schedule. 
One of the most common pieces of feedback we have gotten since launch is that players wish the story were longer. To address this, we have decided to spend more time than originally planned lengthening the story, both the new routes and adding to the story already available. 
Rest assured, we are not planning to just add meaningless padding and are striving to make the story as interesting and rewarding as possible. This means we are extending our original deadlines to accommodate. We hope you will enjoy the new and improved storylines!

Currently, the Pewrep route is almost finished and programmed. The CGs and other artwork are also nearing completion. Very soon, we will finalize the route and begin translation into English, meanwhile continuing to work on the Li Huaisu route. We'll keep you up to date on our progress, so look out for future announcements. 

We have also been testing the implementation of Steam Achievements, and will soon improve controller support so it works consistently across the menus. 

Stay tuned for future updates, and we can't wait to show you what we have been working on.

[b]-LG[/b]
